questions.cardText:
[Mathematics] What is the name of the sequence where each number is the sum of the two preceding ones, starting from 0 and 1?
A. Euler’s Number
B. Prime Number Sequence
C. Fibonacci Sequence
Answer: C. This sequence also appears in many biological settings, such as branching in trees, the arrangement of leaves on a stem, the fruitlets of a pineapple, the flowering of an artichoke, and the arrangement of a pine cone’s bracts.
questions.de: Wie heißt die Zahlenfolge, in der jede Zahl die Summe der beiden vorhergehenden ist, beginnend mit 0 und 1?
questions.en: What is the name of the sequence in which each number is the sum of the two preceding ones, starting from 0 and 1?

timeline.labelEn: Leonardo of Pisa (Fibonacci) introduces the sequence to Western Europe in his book Liber Abaci
timeline.labelDe: Leonardo von Pisa (Fibonacci) macht die Folge mit seinem Buch Liber Abaci in Westeuropa bekannt

questions.notes: Confirmed: F0 = 0, F1 = 1, Fn = Fn−1 + Fn−2. Only the options are dropped; the question was already open.

questions.cardText:
[Geography] Which country has the most number of islands?
A. Indonesia B. Norway C. Sweden
Answer: C. Sweden has around 267,570 islands, the highest number of any country in the world. The Stockholm Archipelago alone contains around 30,000 islands.
questions.de: Welches Land hat die meisten Inseln der Welt, laut einer Zählung seines Statistikamts von 2013 etwa 267.570?
questions.en: Which country has the most islands in the world, about 267,570 according to a 2013 count by its statistics office?

timeline.labelEn: Statistics Sweden counts 267,570 islands in Sweden, fewer than 1,000 of them inhabited
timeline.labelDe: Das schwedische Statistikamt zählt 267.570 Inseln in Schweden, davon weniger als 1.000 bewohnt

questions.notes: Confirmed the 267,570 figure (Statistiska centralbyrån 2013 report). Island counts depend on the definition used, and the Wikipedia list carries an 'inaccurate' update tag; Norway and Finland also report six-figure counts.
